name: GPU Mesh Voxelizer (Grid Generation)
definition: A GPU-based technique to generate a 3D voxel grid by computing the center coordinates of each voxel cell in a compute shader, using the mesh's bounding box and a fixed cell size.
summary: GPU Mesh Voxelizer generates a dense 3D grid by computing voxel centers via compute shaders, differing from rasterization by using bounding box dimensions for uniform cell topology.
